zh-CN.title: 评论互动更顺手
items: 点击评论即可快速回复并自动唤起输入框
评论作者与内容管理者可安全删除评论
删除一级评论时会同步清理其回复线程

en.title: Smoother comment conversations
items: Tap any comment to reply with the composer focused
Comment authors and content moderators can safely remove comments
Removing a top-level comment also cleans up its reply thread
